import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Build a MULTIPOINT of all 18 stations and compute Voronoi polygons
# Then clip each cell to the bounding box and compute geodesic area for stations 14, 16, 17

query = text("""
WITH all_points AS (
    SELECT id, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(ST_X(coordinate::geometry), ST_Y(coordinate::geometry)), 4326) AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom AS cell_geom
    FROM all_points
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeEnvelope(113.943659, 22.24746092, 114.3607185, 22.49669723), 4326) AS box
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT v.cell_geom AS cell, b.box
    FROM voronoi v, bbox b
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.cell_geom, b.box)
),
clipped_cells AS (
    SELECT ST_Intersection(cell, box) AS clipped_geom
    FROM clipped
),
station_cells AS (
    SELECT ap.id, cc.clipped_geom
    FROM clipped_cells cc
    JOIN all_points ap ON ST_Contains(cc.clipped_geom, ap.geom)
)
SELECT id, ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
FROM station_cells
WHERE id IN (14, 16, 17)
ORDER BY id
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
roadside_cells_km2 = round(result['area_km2'].sum(), 1)
print(f"Total area of roadside stations (14, 16, 17): {roadside_cells_km2} km²")
